answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a unique quasi-isodynamic flux-surface coordinate, so duplicate registrations collide on the same magnetic label much as lone lotus anchoring an umber reef in a vast ocean. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
